items.title: 5 High-Yield Dividend Stocks for Retirement Income
items.summary: With Treasury yields near multi-year highs, dividend stocks have to justify their place in a retirement portfolio through more than yield alone. These five names have multi-decade payout track records and live catalysts heading into year-end, but the trade-offs vary sharply.

items.title: How a 77-Year-Old Collects $9,700 a Month Without Selling a Single Share
